facts.text: Fifteen puppies and not one of them can say no to a second helping. Roger, more dinner. The little ones are always hungry.
facts.why: Printed in quote marks as Nanny's words, but it is not a line from the film. Perdita does have 15 puppies and Nanny is their carer, so a signed note in her voice fits. I could not open a quote page for this pass (the search tool was out of budget), so there is no quote source.
facts.fix: Fifteen puppies and not one will say no to a second helping. Roger, more dinner, please.

fix_note.text: Fifteen puppies and not one will say no to a second helping. Roger, more dinner, please.

facts.why: The flat is Roger's bachelor flat before he marries Anita. The 15 puppies are born in the townhouse near Regent's Park, so a flat does not match a menu about the puppies at home.

facts.text: Roger's fuel for writing Cruella De Vil.
facts.why: Roger writes the song Cruella De Vil at the piano, which the plot confirms, but nothing says he drinks gin and tonic while he does it.
facts.fix: Roger's reward after the Cruella De Vil royalties came in.

vibe.verdict: A cosy household menu with the TV show, the soot and the farm friends, but the food is ordinary and the venue is the wrong home.
